patterns.note: Full-width sections with clear visual breaks, often using large imagery or solid background colors, creating distinct content blocks.
Consistent use of uppercase sans-serif for navigation, subheadings, and calls to action, providing a clean, modern, and slightly editorial feel.
A high-contrast palette of dark navy, black, and white, with light grey as a secondary background, creating a sophisticated and clean aesthetic.
A promotional modal appears on initial page load and then reappears after a significant scroll depth, prompting email signup.
Product listings are consistently presented in multi-column grids, typically 3-4 columns, with clear product images and minimal text.

technique_notes: A full-width video element is used as the primary hero background, playing on a loop, with text content overlaid for calls to action.
The main navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, maintaining access to key links and search functionality.
A full-screen overlay modal is triggered both on initial page load and again after the user scrolls past a certain point, prompting email signup.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are generally large and bold sans-serif, often uppercase, contrasting with smaller, lighter body text for descriptions and navigation.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced overall, with generous vertical spacing in the hero and between main sections, while product grids are more densely packed.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a full-bleed, auto-playing video hero combined with a high-contrast, editorial aesthetic creates an immediate sense of modern luxury and dynamic engagement, setting it apart from typical static image heroes. The re-triggering of the email signup modal on scroll is also a notable pattern.
